title: Require a rendered frame before applying carried scale

scope.subject: Gate only the held native wheel coordinate on an actual post-render witness from the existing R3F loop.

research_summary: Cloud profiling found synchronous camera settlement events only 6 ms apart while Orbit and Atmosphere were not guaranteed to be drawn. The existing R3F priority-1 rendering loop is authoritative for actual draws. Add a read-only, order-bound frame callback at priority 2 to release only a single still-current held-coordinate step. No extra FrameLoop, repeated renderer or timer.

sources.finding: Keep the pinned native renderer and its actual applied-frame readiness; neither a generic deadline nor a separate camera may replace it.
Both product variants reproduced the exact first-attempt sample trace under delayed readiness; the existing deterministic signed response distance and saturated segment are the relevant abstraction.
Priority-ordered useFrame subscribers are run in increasing priority. Existing priority 1 owns rendering; the passive priority 2 witness consumes a ref after that same draw.

search_ladder.conclusion: Keep the native implementation and phase ownership.
Keep single Canvas and its phase presentation.
Extend the existing immediate scale intent authority; detached scroll/animation engines cannot preserve these phase contracts.
Keep imperative state and render mirror; no event queue.

candidates.name: Existing signed response mapping and handoff owner
candidates.source: Current UniverseApp, continuousScale and pinned renderer
candidates.reason: Use real delivered deltas with existing bounded domain; commit presentation only when ready, invalidate at reversal and takeover.

candidates.name: Synthesized wheel event replay or inertia
candidates.source: Generic event queues or synthetic gesture continuations
candidates.reason: Adds hidden movement and ownership; rejected.

decision.rationale: Reuse the current R3F rendering order and React refs rather than a fake timeout or creating a new world transition engine.
decision.fallback: If stable direct ownership and immediate reversal cannot be demonstrated, leave isolated and do not publish as release proof.
